description: The pie chart is designed to represent the distribution of two categories, "Efficient deployment" and "Reduction," within a system or process. There are two slices in the chart. The "Efficient deployment" slice is colored blue and accounts for approximately 30.08% of the chart, labeled with the value "26.2s." The "Reduction" slice is colored orange and makes up about 69.92% of the chart, labeled with the value "60.9s." The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices, and there is no legend present. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way; they are simply presented in their respective proportions.
